'use strict';
// 20 concurrent tasks each atomically append one line "1" to counter.txt (O_APPEND),
// then read the file back and print one line of JSON: {"lines":N,"sum":S}.
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'counter.txt');

async function main() {
  // start from zero: remove any old file
  await fs.promises.rm(FILE, { force: true });

  // 20 tasks started concurrently (no serial await in the loop)
  const tasks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    // fs.promises.appendFile -> open(O_APPEND|O_CREAT) + write, atomic append
    tasks.push(fs.promises.appendFile(FILE, '1\n', { encoding: 'utf8' }));
  }
  await Promise.all(tasks);

  // stats must come from actually reading the file
  const raw = await fs.promises.readFile(FILE, 'utf8');
  const lines = raw.split('\n');
  if (lines.length && lines[lines.length - 1] === '') lines.pop(); // trailing newline only

  let sum = 0;
  for (const line of lines) {
    const n = Number.parseInt(line, 10);
    if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(line) || !Number.isSafeInteger(n)) {
      throw new Error('bad line in counter.txt: ' + JSON.stringify(line));
    }
    sum += n;
  }

  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ lines: lines.length, sum }) + '\n');
}

main().catch((err) => {
  process.stderr.write(String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err) + '\n');
  process.exit(1);
});
